description: Deep Sea Electronics genset controllers using the GenComm Modbus protocol. Covers MK I (3110-7450), MK II (4510-8660), and MK III (6110-6120). All generations share the same measurement register map; they differ only in alarm register layout.
notes: GenComm protocol specification. Identification is via registers 768 (manufacturer code) + 769 (model number). Serial number at 770-771 as u32be. Default Modbus unit IDs are 1 or 10. Baud rates: 19200 or 115200 for RTU. Alarm systems differ by generation: MK I uses page 8 (base 2049), MK II/III use Named Alarm Conditions page 154 (base 39425) with family-specific alarm counts. Some registers marked with compatibility notes are only available on newer models (61xx MkII, 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, P100, L40x, 4xxx).

manufacturer_code.description: GenComm manufacturer code (1 = Deep Sea Electronics)

model_number.description: GenComm model number. Used with manufacturer code for device identification.

serial.description: Controller serial number as 32-bit unsigned integer

operating_mode.description: Current operating mode: 0=Stop, 1=Auto, 2=Manual, 3=Test on load, 4=Auto with manual restore, 5=User config, 6=Test off load, 7=Off

status_code.description: Engine status code: 0=Stopped, 1=Pre-start, 2=Warming up, 3=Running, 4=Cooling down, 5=Stopped, 6=Post run, 15=Not available. May not be implemented on all models; fall back to engine speed > 100 RPM for run detection.

ac_total_power.description: Generator total active power. Available on 61xx MkII, 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, P100, L40x, 4xxx.

engine_load.description: Engine load percentage. Available on 61xx MkII, 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, P100, L40x, 4xxx.

engine_operating_hours.description: Total engine operating hours. Available on 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, L40x, 4xxx.

ac_energy_forward.description: Total generated energy. Available on 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, L40x, 4xxx.

engine_starts.description: Total engine start count. Available on 8xxx, 7xxx, 6xxx, L40x, 4xxx.

scf_support_flags.description: GenComm System Control Function support flags. 8 registers of 16-bit flags indicating which control functions the controller supports.

scf_command.description: GenComm System Control Function command register. Write SCF key to 4104 and its two's complement (65535 - key) to 4105. Key 35701=Select Auto, 35732=Telemetry Start, 35733=Telemetry Stop.
